title: Mixed Event — Bustling Cafe ●REC! — Episode6 MMJ's Impromptu Cafe!

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP!'s latest gig is a TV segment on location at a popular cafe! Little do they realize, it's none other than the cafe where Minori works!

rows.Line: A few minutes later
carino/carina

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Welcome to carino/carina!

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line: I can't really see because of the curtains, but it definitely sounds like Airi Momoi and Haruka Kiritani are doing a shoot!

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line: Yeah, I just saw in the news that they're both in a different idol group now. Do you think they're all here today?

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line: Oh, what if this means they're gonna serve us...?! How amazing would that be?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe. The customers sure all sound excited.)

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line:
Wait, where's Shizuku Hinomori...?
I became a huge fan after seeing a recording of one of the shows she was on. I really wanted to see her in person...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Just a second.
Shizuku's getting ready as we speak.

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line:
...!
Airi Momoi...!

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line: Wait, getting ready? For...?
Welcome, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's so wonderful to be making your acquaintance today. I hope you enjoy everything.

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line: Sh...

rows.Speaker: Customers
rows.Line: She's looks so cool!!!

rows.Speaker: Staff
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Show Director
rows.Line:
You, focus on Hinomori!
Lock your camera onto her!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So much excitement...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Her aura really is brilliant.
Like, blindingly brilliant...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Still, this was a great idea.
How do you think they arrived on getting Shizuku to wear the male staff's uniform?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess it wouldn't have been all that interesting if we all just dressed as regular waitresses.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I thought we could do just that, but the stylist insisted she do this...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see.
And she looks stunning. I'm sure the customers are going to really enjoy this.

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line:
U-Um... Excuse me...
Would you mind if we took a picture together?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Speaking of which, there's a nice area for taking pictures at the back of this cafe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Why don't we go there?
You may or may not appear on TV if that's okay.

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, of course...!
I don't mind as long I'm allowed to have a picture!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Great.
Then, I'll go grab Shizuku now, so—

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line:
Oh...!
N-No, I meant...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line:
I want to take a picture with you, Airi.
I've been a fan of yours since you were still in training... And I watch MORE MORE JUMP! streams all the time.

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line: You don't get many chances in life like this...! But I also apologize if I'm asking for too much...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, of course!
Thank you for being such a fervent supporter.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's celebrate this moment by putting on the biggest smiles we can!

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Airi...! She's right next to me...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Then, why don't I take it for you?
Mind giving me your phone?

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line: K-Kiritani?! You're taking it for us...?! Thank you so much! I don't know what to say...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, smile.

rows.Speaker: Customer
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much!
I'll treasure this moment forever...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Promise?
No hopping onto someone else's bandwagon, okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I won't forget what you told me today, and I look forward to seeing you at our next show.

rows.Speaker: Fujin
rows.Line: Whoa, hold up. We're allowed to ask for pictures? Take some with us next.

rows.Speaker: Wrestlers
rows.Line:
Yeah, I wanna post them on PicShare!
Let's take some as a group!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It's turned into a photo shoot all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
But I don't mind as long as we can use this area. Here, we should be able to stay out of the cafe staff's way.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also... I appreciate that you want to post them on PicShare, but please make sure to mention this cafe and TV program when you do!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone's having so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, they're so caught up in trying to take pictures that we've been getting less orders!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This is our chance to get everything out!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, we can't let Airi's efforts go to waste!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Right!
Also, Minori, thanks for jumping in to help with the kitchen! We feel so much better having you around.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I should be the one thanking you! Our shoot's been going well because you've all been doing such a great job so far!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Especially you, Mizuki. It's hard to believe this is your first day considering how many orders you've been handling!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If I'm gonna be honest, I was really worried in the beginning... But that massive pile of orders ended up being a good crash course.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then, Mizuki, I've got a job for you!
I just finished working on the bottom halves of these parfaits, so mind doing the whipped cream for me?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you got it!
These going to Emu's table, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
And can you take these out to them when you're done?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: After that, I'll need you to help decorate the waffles. But they still need some time to cook.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna make these look perfect!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Everyone's having so much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Look at how their eyes are sparkling!
It's like we're all a part of a big show!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're right.
And I'm looking forward to our parfaits.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thank you very much for waiting!
Here are your Mount Everest strawberry parfaits!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, yay!
Our Mount Everests have arrived♪

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Wow, they're so big...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm sorry that they took a little longer than expected to make. Things have been so busy today that, well... I hope it hasn't been too much of a bother.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: No, we've been having a lot of fun! We were just talking about how this all feels like a big show!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm glad you're both enjoying things so much! And I really hope you enjoy these!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Actually, I'm surprised at how cute these parfaits are. I can see why so many people would want to take pictures and show their friends.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I wanna take some for Nene and the others!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I mean, just look at this bow!
It looks so real! It's a shame that we have to eat it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Actually, I was the one who did all the whipped cream decorations for these...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Mizuki, you made these?!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
But you said it's your first day here, no?
You're so talented.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, I'm just sorta good at decorating things. Still...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really appreciate what you just said since I put everything I had into these.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I guarantee that they taste amazing, so I really hope you enjoy them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, then...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We promise to savor every bite of the parfaits you so lovingly made, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
In that case...!
Bon appetite!
